title: Novuscore Softcom Solution Launches AI-Powered "Dhana-Krishaka" Chatbot to Empower Indian Farmers | User | dailytimesleader.com
text:
Surat, Gujarat - March 5, 2025 - Novuscore Softcom Solution Private Limited, an emerging innovator in AgriTech solutions, today announced the pilot launch of Dhana-Krishaka , an AI-driven chatbot designed to revolutionize agricultural decision-making for farmers across India. This groundbreaking initiative aims to bridge the gap between technology and farming communities by providing real-time, localized assistance in multiple languages, ensuring accessibility for all.
Dhana-Krishaka: A Digital Companion for Farmers
Developed through intensive research and development, Dhana-Krishaka leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and natural language processing (NLP) to deliver instant, actionable answers to farmers' queries. The platform supports English, Hindi, and Gujarati, catering to the linguistic diversity of India's farming population. The application features sophisticated capabilities designed specifically for agricultural communities in rural areas.
The new platform incorporates several innovative components to address the unique challenges faced by Indian farmers. The system provides 24/7 multilingual support, allowing farmers to voice or text queries in their preferred language, effectively breaking literacy barriers that have historically limited technology adoption in rural areas. The integration with comprehensive agricultural databases enables real-time insights on weather forecasts, crop prices, pest control methods, and government subsidy updates, creating a one-stop information resource for farming communities.
Dhana-Krishaka's AI algorithms analyze soil health, crop cycles, and market trends to offer personalized recommendations tailored to each farmer's specific conditions and needs. Understanding the connectivity challenges in rural India, the development team has created a user-friendly interface optimized for low-bandwidth environments, complete with voice commands and visual aids for maximum accessibility.
Driving Impact in Rural Communities
The pilot project will initially roll out in Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Punjab, targeting over 10,000 farmers. By delivering critical information directly to farmers' fingertips, Dhana-Krishaka empowers agricultural professionals to optimize resources, reduce losses, and enhance yields through informed decision-making. The platform's timely weather alerts can help prevent crop damage, while accurate market price data ensures farmers engage in fair trade practices.
Leadership Perspective
Mr. Suresh Jangid, Visionary CEO of Novuscore Softcom Solution Private Limited, stated, "Dhana-Krishaka represents our commitment to democratizing technology for rural India. Having established our company in 2023, we've been working diligently to develop solutions that address real challenges in the agricultural sector. By combining AI with deep agricultural expertise, we're not just solving problems—we're transforming livelihoods and creating sustainable impact in farming communities."
Mr. Jangid, who brings valuable experience in software development and technology innovation, has been instrumental in guiding the company's strategic vision since its inception in July 2023. Under his leadership, Novuscore has rapidly established itself as a forward-thinking player in the Information Technology industry with a focus on practical applications for rural development.
Ms. Li Wei, CTO of FUTURETEQ, added, “Our robust tech stack, including TensorFlow and OpenAI GPT-4, ensures KishanDani evolves with user needs, making it a sustainable solution for modern farming.”
Future Roadmap
Following the 3-month pilot, Novuscore plans to expand Dhana-Krishaka nationwide, incorporating user feedback to add regional languages and advanced features like drone-based crop monitoring. The company is actively pursuing partnerships with state agricultural departments and NGOs to scale outreach and maximize the platform's positive impact.
About Novuscore Softcom Solution Private Limited
Headquartered in Surat, Gujarat, Novuscore Softcom Solution Private Limited specializes in innovative technology solutions with a focus on addressing real-world challenges. Founded in July 2023, the company has quickly established itself in the Information Technology industry under the leadership of directors Suresh Jangid and Hemraj Jangid. Committed to inclusive innovation, Novuscore aims to leverage technology to empower communities across India.
